title: Containment Material Step-Down by Contract Size — Installation Jobs
content:
**Containment material step-down — Installation Jobs**

Containment material is bought by the job, so a larger contract earns a step-down on the lead-safe fee of an **Installation Jobs** record. The band is set by the openings on the contract the job installs — the **Window Replacement Contracts** contract of a window job, or the units on the **Entry & Patio Door Contracts** contract of a door job — and the step-down is taken off the fee for every opening on the job:

| Openings on the contract the job installs | Step-down |
|---|---|
| more than 24 | $5.00 per opening on the job off the fee |
| 13 to 24 | $2.00 per opening on the job off the fee |
| 12 or fewer | nothing off |

The band reads the contract's openings; the amount taken off is the step-down multiplied by the openings on the job.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical contracts and jobs)

| Contract openings | Openings on the job | Taken off |
|---|---|---|
| 25 | 25 | 25 times 5.00, that is 125.00 |
| 24 | 24 | 24 times 2.00, that is 48.00 |
| 13 | 13 | 26.00 |
| 12 | 12 | nothing |
| 30 | 18 | 18 times 5.00, that is 90.00 |
